notes: ottawacitizen.com is a Postmedia WordPress site. Tried, in order: (1) robots.txt -> 200, allows the public paths (Disallow /wp-admin/ and /*?, with explicit Allow lines for /sitemap-story.xml? etc.), names /sitemap.xml, /sitemap-news.xml, /sitemap-story.xml, /sitemap-category.xml, /sitemap-video.xml. (2) /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=3 -> 200, so the WP REST archive is open; the 'Disallow: /*?' rule is not matched against these query URLs by polite_fetch's robotparser (matches nationalpost-com, same platform). (3) /wp-json/wp/v2/types -> 200, only 'post'/'page' are content types, so nothing is hidden behind a custom post type in the REST index. (4) /wp-json/postmedia/v1 -> 200 but only menus/sidebars/options, no post listing. (5) /sitemap-story.xml?y=2026&m=10 -> 404 (monthly form does not exist, only per-day). (6) Wayback CDX for 20261010-20261011 -> 503, unusable (matches other workers' reports). FINAL ROUTE: union of two site-owned routes, both status 200. A) REST pagination /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&_fields=link,date,date_gmt&after=2026-09-23T00:00:00&before=2026-10-27T00:00:00&page=1..4 ; listed date = date-part of the site-local 'date' field (America/Toronto publish time, NOT 'modified'), verified == page JSON-LD datePublished on 6 samples. B) per-day story sitemaps /sitemap-story.xml?y=&m=&d= for each of the 31 days; used to fill in URLs REST misses (it misses three /feature/ long reads) and as a full fallback if REST fails; for those, date = date-part of <lastmod> when inside the window. Cross-check: for all 31 days the REST count and the per-day sitemap count agreed (identical on 28 days, sitemap +1 on 3 days = exactly the /feature/ pages), so the archive is complete. Runtime 36 s, ~35 requests (4 REST pages + 31 sitemaps). Output: 366 unique URLs, 31/31 days. LOW VOLUME IS REAL: 2026-09-30 = 12 URLs, 2026-10-10 = 6 URLs (both routes agree exactly, 12 vs 12 and 6 vs 6), 2026-10-20 = 17. Minimum day is 4 (10-04 and 10-18). The 10-10 dip is the Canadian Thanksgiving long weekend (Sat 10-10=6, Sun 10-11=5, Mon 10-12=7) against 12-23 on ordinary weekdays; 09-30 was a plain Wednesday at 12. Re-fetched 6 sample articles (2 per judged day, plus 2 /feature/ pages): all HTTP 200, page datePublished equal to the listed date, 9,599-62,523 chars of visible text.
